counter_hypotheses.test: compare GHG01 physical gas-store/process classification and GHG_Miner source-pool intent against the proposed no-debit interpretation
counter_hypotheses.reason: QPrCH4 is a physical CH4-C source into dynamic GHG state; omitting a matching source-family C debit creates carbon

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: TCD032 can be solved by re-enabling both legacy GHG_Miner calls unchanged

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: every source pool can be debited only by Q_j*dt/f_C, irrespective of retained incorporation
counter_hypotheses.test: exact rational negative control removes the I_j credit while preserving a_j>0
counter_hypotheses.reason: when a_j>0 the gross source debit exceeds net CH4 conversion; omitting the matching internal credit over-debits organic C

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Rates2 can retain its DOM debit while a separate GHG transfer owner debits DOM again
counter_hypotheses.reason: the resulting net source C loss exceeds Q_dom*dt exactly
